autonomous_replay.action: Resolve the actual repository/head and intended consumer; bind original bytes, producer strata, IDs and body correspondence independently. Retain source-person/host/relationship/self scopes.

autonomous_replay.action: Search current authorized stores and evidence first. Distinguish source decomposition from conditional teaching targets. Use the owner-designated teacher; this ALICE run explicitly excludes another teacher. Ask the owner about actual ambiguity, not settled routine scope.

autonomous_replay.action: Author complete target-free documents and separate typed annotations. Historical closeness does not fill present permission. Include multiple valid options and genuine explicit contrasts; judge each semantic dimension separately. Mark unsupported voice/uncertainty/outcome targets unavailable. Explicitly place permitted literal synthetic policies and complete active support closure into consumer sources; author background alone does not connect the prior. Preserve public/private and relationship applicability without inventing unobserved outputs.

autonomous_replay.stop_if: A style mismatch is copied to every judgment head, a hypothetical becomes history, or unselected source alternatives become negatives.

autonomous_replay.action: Localize failures before model mutation. Categorical distributions cover declared alternatives and sum to one; independent head qualities are separately judged. Construct all targets through the actual deterministic consumer; keep mechanics distinct from publisher or behavioral evidence.

autonomous_replay.stop_if: Targets use the wrong probability domain, a categorical row is all-zero, or a schema failure is labeled a learned-model defect.

autonomous_replay.action: Establish actual owner isolation before private paths/reads. Pass only the target-free document to the frozen producer. Close and recheck source; materialize named sparse targets against the exact frame/geometry and phase. If the caller retains protected features, preserve the producer no-cache binding and record caller custody separately; verify own checksum-bound artifact reload.
autonomous_replay.input: Pinned full document, annotation protocol, author review, source/compiler and prepared-base receipts
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Targets/review prose leak into provider text, session source recheck is absent, bindings change, or stage/split authority is inferred.

autonomous_replay.action: Trace the complete route and compare enforced prerequisites with owner sequencing. Separate working components, missing curriculum/consumer and unsupported design hypotheses. Discuss the concrete upstream correction before more fixes. Once the owner authorizes a concrete correction, implement it through discriminating regressions and the actual intended consumer; do not remain in route-review loops.

autonomous_replay.stop_if: The executable trainer contradicts the agreed build sequence or a component result is presented as completion of the full model.

autonomous_replay.action: Preserve source dependencies while distinguishing shared immutable identity references from fresh teaching/outcome ancestry. Determine whether the calibration inputs can represent each intended outcome; build substantive N1/N2 and the actual consumer before full capability qualification.

autonomous_replay.stop_if: TRAIN references are renamed to manufacture independence, source confidence becomes outcome gold, or N3 calibrates an unlearned arbitrary fidelity score.

autonomous_replay.action: Claim learned control only for nonzero effective targets: uncertain facts and constant singleton distributions are unavailable. Bind family and full semantic label meaning/unit/range. Consume trained pairwise preferences as well as scalar preferences; preserve genuine co-valid alternatives and unresolved ties.
autonomous_replay.input: Actual sparse target masks, objective domains, optimized checkpoint evidence and exact semantic label specifications
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Opaque label IDs, mere annotation availability or candidate ordering are presented as learned semantic decisions.

autonomous_replay.action: Profile actual unique entries before expensive extraction. Compare estimates with both declared budget and allocated resources. Retain complete source-bound features once, close original sessions, stream real phase training and save resumable optimizer state every completed epoch. Record actual sizes and memory separately from estimates.
autonomous_replay.input: Exact target-free source closure, tokenizer and full layer geometry; actual scheduler allocation and protected disk

autonomous_replay.action: Train only the intended learned components through the real admitted route, retain resumable checkpoints, and connect word/delivery consumers. Complete substantive N3 calibration and the intended full build before full capability evaluation.
autonomous_replay.input: Concrete reviewable source/target manifest, actual current training authority and complete governing components
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A compiler pass, author proposal or feature receipt is being treated as gradient admission or trained personality.

autonomous_replay.action: Measure intended interpretation, judgment, expression and calibration with matched controls. Diagnose inherited-base interference, research the actual causal mechanism, repair the responsible interface/objective and preserve residual limits. Capture useful methods with paired evidence.
autonomous_replay.input: Connected trained consumer and suitable independent evidence/interventions
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Unqualified mechanics, teacher fit or source custody is being promoted to independent personality fidelity.

autonomous_replay.action: Validate the failure claim before architecture diagnosis. Distinguish infrastructure loss and restart from training failure. Preserve original evidence and explicit unknowns. Disable unsupported automatic restart; retain logs and use a fresh pinned continuation. Reuse complete actually closed features through the real source validator; resume learned state only from a verified published optimizer checkpoint.
autonomous_replay.input: Original submission, complete scheduler attempt history, logs and actually guarded source/checkpoint inventory
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Latest-only accounting conceals an earlier attempt, partial work is called complete, source closure is manufactured, or unpublished optimizer progress is invented.

autonomous_replay.action: Recalibrate on a real failure. Establish what was completed and which phase consumed the budget. Use one matched fully admitted step with timed producer/materializer/admission/optimizer/checkpoint boundaries to distinguish native compute, repeated custody work and supported runtime hypotheses. Select a coherent correction only from the result; preserve the full model, curriculum and governing guarantees.
autonomous_replay.input: Complete attempt evidence, guarded saved artifacts and timestamps, unchanged training path and exact runtime documentation
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A last console line is treated as a root cause, a smaller fixture is called full learning, or limits/targets/custody are weakened to make the run pass.

autonomous_replay.action: Use the empirically viable thread configuration before eager/autograd work. Bind actual allocation to the owner plan. Retain complete data, role objectives, integrity checks, recipe and limits. Preserve censored results and operator uncertainty; verify the full successor before declaring learned capability.
autonomous_replay.input: Matched full admitted operation with identical inputs/authority and guarded saved checkpoint
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A one-step control is promoted to whole-curriculum fit, a timeout justifies architecture mutation, or unverified optimizer progress is resumed.

autonomous_replay.action: Keep actor/executor claims as proposals. Verify relevant postconditions through source-native checks where possible; preserve verification basis and fallibility. Failed/partial/unresolved attempts may teach specific failure hypotheses but do not become verified-success procedures. Later contradiction can demote descendants without rewriting attempted experience.
autonomous_replay.input: Actual observed results, source postconditions, owner/outcome evidence and unresolved attempts
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Self-reported success, teacher confidence, source custody or a completed job is being promoted to personal fidelity, calibrated outcome or shared builder competence.

autonomous_replay.action: Reconstruct complete finite native state and verify original full responses; preserve transport semantics with canonical bytes and native fingerprints. Fresh N3-only admission/optimizer; preserve fixed N1/N2, original source/splits, unavailable owner/acoustic/outcome facts, and full downstream output.
autonomous_replay.input: Actual verified N1/N2 chain and source-bound selected response, primary sparse review and explicit calibration ancestry
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A raw-container mismatch is treated as model drift, wrong responses are replaced as observed outcomes, or model confidence/hypothetical consequences become fidelity gold.

autonomous_replay.action: Preserve full verdict and fingerprint, distinguish preference and taught validity, expose unresolved contradiction without reranking, and bind current label meaning/unit to actual reviewed fingerprints. Keep N1 conditional scope and actual unavailable fields explicit.
autonomous_replay.input: Actual full native IDP, exact checkpoint events, current semantic labels and original preferred response
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Raw diagnostics or global coverage are promoted to current label teaching, a wrong native judgment is hidden by consumer mechanics, or a completed job is called faithful personality.

autonomous_replay.action: Validate evidence, distinguish conditional representation fit from governing generalization, and use one actual causal contrast to choose the responsible teaching correction. Retain source/split ancestry, unresolved ambiguity and original failures. Then return to full personality construction.
autonomous_replay.input: Actual assembled outputs, original source/target semantics, training-fit comparison and stage responsibility
autonomous_replay.stop_if: N3 is retried to reverse N2 rank/sign, capacity/architecture is changed without a supported cause, or roots review becomes a standing qualification/edge-case program.

autonomous_replay.action: Preserve identity/source/candidate authority and duplicated current context; use fresh source-verified full extraction for new texts; retain derivative split ancestry, tokens, complete native judgments, unknowns and original failures. Diagnose provider versus first-party governors before a supported correction.
autonomous_replay.input: Role-specific prepared source, actual native consumer, coherent matched documents and separate primary review
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Old replay is offered as fresh source verification, targets reach N0, residual governing influence becomes an accepted identity feature, or two TRAIN-derived families are called independent full qualification.

autonomous_replay.action: Verify original file/row seals and invariant authority. Compare pre-calibration logit and post-calibration probability changes. Keep latent sensitivity separate from authentic context understanding and qualify the conclusion by actual tested scope.

autonomous_replay.stop_if: Saturated probabilities are used to infer an unused representation without examining raw scores, small intervention effects become proof of absent base semantics, or unfinished authentic evidence is replaced by a speculative architecture/optimizer change.

autonomous_replay.action: Audit actual target meanings and missing heads; author dimension-eliciting individual and interacting lessons. Review specific sources; retain E0/E-INF/A-SYN/own-experience/self authority and characteristic asymmetries. Separate teaching from runtime and genuine-evidence dependencies.
autonomous_replay.input: Role/comic contracts, actual reviewed targets, source pool and consumer responsibilities
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Counts or topic names become learned coverage; generic agreeable behavior replaces character; simulated outcomes become A-EXP or source-card support is copied as gold.

autonomous_replay.action: Distinguish exact resume from new admission; retain compatible learned tensors and valid replay, explicitly bind transferred objective state and updated/preserved stages. Implement successor lineage without dummy N1 updates. Refresh actual calibration applicability after governor changes.
autonomous_replay.input: Verified trained parent, compatible semantics, corrected/additional reviewed curriculum
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Changed teaching is slipped into exact resume; semantic fingerprints are aliased; old erroneous responses are preserved as gold or data growth triggers routine random stage remakes.

autonomous_replay.action: Author all justified interpretation fields and separate independent judgment dimensions; preserve unknowns. Define relative expressive-request units before assigning provisional intent values/confidence. Compare exact serialized prior facts to retain valid replay and explicitly supersede clarified annotations. Keep source bodies and learned behavior private.
autonomous_replay.input: Individually read source policies, attributed permitted history, hypothetical current premises, exact native target types
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Guessed schema names replace inspected APIs; numerical voice intent becomes acoustic/owner gold; changed case hashes are presented as exact parent batch fingerprints; a source policy becomes lived history.

autonomous_replay.action: Enforce executable pin at queued dispatch, guard private access first, retain complete source geometry, close and reopen actual features and materialize every selected case. Continue compatible model state under a new admission with explicit objective transfer and valid replay. Preserve native semantic teaching gates in renderer and final receipt; calibration refines confidence rather than creating personality meaning.
autonomous_replay.input: Externally pinned public worker, exact private packet, full frozen base, native optimized parent and original consumer contract
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Shape fixture or scheduler acceptance becomes learning/qualification; archived superseded teaching reenters silently; old N3 is advertised current after governor changes; private tensors move to an unapproved surface.

autonomous_replay.action: Preserve original failures. Verify complete identities and unchanged targets. Compare retained/new cases separately by phase and semantic field; case losses are not independent accuracy. Inspect actual diagnostic probabilities and controls before selecting a supported correction. Keep acquisition, retention, phase attribution and calibration applicability distinct.
autonomous_replay.input: Terminal accounting, exact sealed worker summary, original matched objectives and responses, full native checkpoint lineage
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Scheduler success is called behavioral repair; equal aggregate errors are called unchanged predictions; per-step losses on different examples become a convergence curve; repeated epochs, target edits or a new optimizer are selected without causal evidence.

autonomous_replay.action: Measure the full teaching set at the retained intermediate stage using its actual native consumer and auxiliary objective. Compare every matched field against saved endpoints. Reproduce endpoint packets before attributing raw signal changes; keep paired condition sensitivity separate from global score shifts. Preserve successful acquired behavior while localizing retention regressions.
autonomous_replay.input: Verified parent/intermediate/final checkpoints, unchanged complete admitted cases and original source-bound diagnostic conditions
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A score movement is called conditional understanding, endpoint reproduction fails, checkpoint/objective/feature identities differ, or a read-only diagnostic is turned into speculative retraining.

autonomous_replay.action: Distinguish context sensitivity from common score movement and acquisition from retention. Reuse sealed native records for a cheap path readback. If the evidence supports an update-composition hypothesis, compare independent copies with identical complete endpoint objectives, case inventory, per-case coefficients and optimizer budget; pair by reviewed semantic ancestry, not model errors. Preserve original checkpoints and record grouped experiments under a distinct schema. Report all affected fields, original failures, repairs and harms before choosing a production continuation.
autonomous_replay.input: Exact intermediate/final native measurements, existing reviewed condition families, full compatible teaching ancestry and retained targets
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Missing source meaning is inferred from IDs, crossed group sizes change case weight, missing/unknown targets become false labels, a numerical gradient test confuses accumulation roundoff with a rule change, an experimental state is called native-v7 resumable, or local mechanics/scheduler success is promoted to learned judgment or N0 qualification.

autonomous_replay.action: Distinguish infrastructure failure from learning evidence. Reuse complete baseline measurements only after full source/frame/session/model/checkpoint rebinding. Save immutable completed-group model/auxiliary/AdamW/RNG/cursor/event state; publish a manifest pin after durable write and before acknowledging progress. Re-admit all batches and require explicit external pin plus identical runtime/plan/parameter order before recovery. Compare actual uninterrupted and interrupted native trajectories exactly; validate storage on the actual execution host. Keep full scientific endpoint evaluation and all original checkpoints.
autonomous_replay.input: Full scheduler accounting/logs, guarded failed-output inventory, sealed complete prior measurements and unchanged authorized scientific plan
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Only partial baseline exists, gradients were partly accumulated, a snapshot lacks an independent pin, custody or runtime changes, native checkpoint semantics are falsely claimed, or scheduler success is used as personality qualification.

autonomous_replay.action: Validate whether execution reached the scientific test. Trace the first failure across resource ownership and cleanup, not just the final exception. Confirm the suspected destructive lifecycle transition with an actual-runtime negative control. Preserve original entry cleanup and introduce separately pinned non-destructive verification only for an already-entered process; retain every source/descriptor/path/hash and final-closure guarantee. Exercise the actual worker connection and native update trajectory with held resources; compare exact model/optimizer/RNG/events and reject drift. Preserve sanitized causal exceptions and a safe reporter fallback. Rerun the unchanged full scientific experiment only after these controls pass.
autonomous_replay.input: Full terminal accounting/logs, guarded stage inventory, original isolation entry implementation, caller lifetime and owned resource pins
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A startup operation is repeated during live ownership, a cleanup exception obscures the original cause, a reporter may expose protected messages, custody is weakened, runtime evidence is mocked, or public mechanics success is treated as private learning qualification.

autonomous_replay.action: Confirm execution/custody/coverage, then evaluate intended changed-condition behavior and retained harms field by field. Preserve negative experiments when mean loss hides failures. Distinguish unchanged binary targets from changed preference targets; retain family denominators and optimizer/order confounds. Before new training, inspect complete saved pairs at each frozen endpoint. Align candidate identities, native source-plus-concept views and current subject roles with full authority verification. Preserve the original probability-based test while using logits/margins to inspect small conditional effects. Test the actual native codec, not only synthetic assumed shapes. Inspect explicit N1 target accuracy before assuming its representation changes establish correct interpretation. Treat distances as descriptive; use frozen authentic/sham/natural-partner/reviewed-value interventions to test a particular channel. Reviewed replacements deliberately contain targets; never count them as inferred capability or training. Preserve unknown and unchanged facts and all authority. A weak result bounds the selected channel and interventions, not all possible N1 repairs; require result before assigning cause or retraining.
autonomous_replay.input: Complete pinned comparison outputs, actual native model/codec, reviewed condition-pair ancestry and targets, retained objectives and control families
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Aggregate loss is treated as governing personality behavior, dependent variants as independent examples, one schedule as a general causal verdict, a native shape as an assumed mock, or a descriptive latent change as a causal bottleneck.

autonomous_replay.action: Validate complete native execution and prior controls before interpreting failed behavior. Preserve negative selected-channel interventions without generalizing them to all N1 or assigning a Gemma cause. Connect the actual native transformation to primary papers and pinned upstream code; distinguish useful mechanisms from incompatible authority or scalar reward assumptions. Localize effect changes with passive native stage observations, all available current reviewed conditional facts, exact prior variant packet/objective reproduction, actual changed-fact counts, and per-context repair/harm transitions. Reuse exact frozen projections only within the same checked model/frame/query session. Keep originals, source closure, unknown facts, masks, rich latent/source paths and all output dimensions. Treat normalization-boundary observations and cross-layer norms as bounded evidence, not a unique causal explanation. A penalty accepting correction-ignoring models cannot by itself solve insensitivity. Choose at most one evidence-supported learning or connection correction after the result; require natural governing judgment and retention, separate from target-bearing diagnostic improvement.
autonomous_replay.input: Complete pinned frozen intervention result; actual N1/N2/N3 path; original source and reviewed-target ancestry; primary papers and upstream code
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A small aggregate loss change becomes a behavioral pass; unchanged totals hide per-context harms; rich residuals are deleted; a branch/gate or monotonic penalty is adopted without local evidence; or diagnostic labels become qualification.

autonomous_replay.action: Validate terminal accounting, all native controls, custody and exact prior reproduction before interpreting a negative diagnostic. Treat stage attenuation and direct concept-pointer effects as bounded observations, not a uniquely proven architectural cause. Use the researched before/after task-supervision principle in one falsifiable native N2 learning comparison before changing architecture. Admit corrections separately from diagnostic probes: original same-document TRAIN N1 case, full annotations, reviewed materialization and reconstructed batch fingerprint, source/frame/session and unchanged N2 targets. Keep unavailable/fully uncertain facts and forbidden authority untouched. Compare identical complete groups with half natural and half replay loss in both arms; only treatment replay receives corrections. Preserve all native judgment fields, frozen Gemma/N1/N3 and original checkpoints; retain exact experimental model/optimizer/RNG/event state after every group. Require ordinary contextual judgment and full-curriculum retention, while separately reporting full and partial supplied-correction responses. Oracle-assisted improvement is not natural repair or qualification. Record method and evidence in FBM without private identity payload, builder-weight updates or inflated readiness claims.
autonomous_replay.input: Complete stage trace, original reviewed same-context TRAIN N1/N2 cases and exact native ancestry, primary IntCEM evidence
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Correction facts lack independent original admission; new targets are invented; schedules or full losses differ; only corrected outputs improve; retained governance worsens; or observed attenuation is asserted as unique architecture failure.

autonomous_replay.action: Identify an essential integration whose inputs are already stable and whose acceptance does not need a pending learning result. Connect the actual complete sealed native decision artifact to the existing Experience envelope and writer, preserving external payload digest and model/document/frame/session/checkpoint lineage. Keep raw identity content in caller-owned payload custody, not metadata. Record decision construction, including unresolved realization, without claiming performed action, success, historical truth, owner acceptance or N3 labels. Delegate storage identity, append, duplicate and replay semantics to the canonical writer; schema versions are not different host/encryption identities. Verify with an actual optimized public consumer and real durable ledger, preserve invalid setup evidence and scope regression, then capture the method without changing the running job or private models.
autonomous_replay.input: Stable governed-response receipt and existing Experience envelope/writer; exact saved payload, explicit caller source scope and custody
autonomous_replay.stop_if: Work needs pending model results; a new memory owner is invented; output confidence becomes gold; metadata stores raw identity; or source/host authority is inferred from a hash.

autonomous_replay.action: Validate terminal accounting, all committed updates, full-curriculum objectives, natural and corrected decisions, exact export and closing custody before interpreting learning. Preserve a negative behavioral verdict despite aggregate objective improvement; separate individual context repairs and harms, target-direction compatibility, calibration gaps, same-state replay effects and temporal retention. Match actual objective participation: unknown facts remain None/None, distribution certainty weights a whole row, and independent pair facts have their own weights. Use saved source-bound artifacts to discriminate finite explanations before model, optimizer or label changes. Task-gradient conflict requires gradient evidence, not loss magnitudes. If exact target agreement and saved transitions do not resolve the cause, reproduce the original pre-update trajectory over the full curriculum without optimizer steps. Decompose complete weighted task gradients, preserve individual, paired and combined natural/replay cancellation, and compare with actual clipped AdamW parameter changes. Label derivatives as local sensitivity, not global causal proof. Rewind hash-verified descriptors, verify actual public-input producer permissions, and stage identical owner-only copies without altering original scheduler evidence or weakening private checks. Preserve failed deployments and exact tested sources. Keep source/host/relationship/self and E0/E-INF/A-SYN/A-EXP authority separate; capture procedure-only FBM and return to full capability construction once the cause is supported.
autonomous_replay.input: Complete matched full-native learning artifacts, original admitted reviewed targets, full retained decisions and original failure evidence
autonomous_replay.stop_if: A lower aggregate objective masks wrong governing choices; loss magnitude becomes gradient proof; supplied labels become ordinary inference; partial targets become outcomes; or repeated runs replace causal diagnosis.

role_contract.boundary: A source-person identity, host, relationship and assistant-self remain separate. Evidence categories span stages. Other model roles require their own objectives and consumers.
role_contract.eipm: Preserve qualitative words/delivery, conditions and identity through the real consumer; exact acoustics require separate evidence.
role_contract.n0: Frozen prepared headless full semantic features. N1–N3/EIPM govern personality; established residual inherited governing influence is a defect requiring practical suppression. Source preparation is not approval.
role_contract.n1: Conditional interpretation, concept applicability, source support/disconfirmation and available uncertainty.
role_contract.n2: Source-grounded governing judgment, multiple valid choices, separate semantic dimensions and expressive intent.
role_contract.n3: Separate calibration from actual judgment/outcome or owner fidelity evidence; never source-confidence copies.

scope: Full Fable v1 personality construction; host-neutral procedure seed with paired ALICE evidence
